verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents driveItem addressing, search by query, delta, versions, and thumbnails. None of it describes custom metadata or property templates that can be defined, set on files, and queried through the API. The community remark that SharePoint adds metadata to documents describes system behavior, not a developer-defined schema, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API
